updates.new_facts: Norman's villain turn was engineered through social engineering by Elizabeth Pristine, who framed him as a killer and pushed him into becoming Norman the Paleborne.
updates.quote: A shapeshifting girl aligned with Khalid, Elizabeth Pristine, stages events to break Liam–Norman trust. She frames Norman as the killer, fakes “saving” him, and pushes him into the point-of-no-return.

updates.new_facts: Eldrich's romantic partner was Elina Quins. After Dorian's death and Khalid's revenge, Eldrich became half-demonic and vanished, and is presumed dead while visiting various graves from the shadows.
updates.quote: After Dorian’s death and Khalid’s revenge, Eldrich becomes half-demonic and vanishes; presumed dead. Elina never remarries; Eldrich watches from shadows; she dies of old age while he remains.

timeline_events.title: Origin of the Duskmoor Bloodline
timeline_events.description: A dragon fell in love with a human, creating a hybrid bloodline. A weak female spirit used a human form, loved by a hybrid, but upon seeing her true form, the hybrid called her ugly, killed her, and abandoned the child, who was then raised by spirits to start the Duskmoor bloodline.
timeline_events.quote: A weak female spirit used a human form; a hybrid loved her human form; they had a child; then the hybrid saw her true spirit form, called her ugly, killed her, and abandoned the child. Spirits raised that child → Duskmoor bloodline begins.

timeline_events.title: Diablo War
timeline_events.description: An ancient demon incursion led by Diablo and a Prince of Demons was forced to retreat due to Tedmond's presence, kid-Dorian's madness aura, and Norman's fearlessness.
timeline_events.quote: Ancient demon incursion led by Diablo (Right Hand of the Devil) and a Prince of Demons. Tedmond’s presence + kid-Dorian’s “madness” aura + Norman’s fearlessness forced Diablo to retreat.
